title: Effects of Proportioning Meat and Plant-based Protein-rich Foods on Cardiovascular Disease Risk Factors (S58)
brief_summary: This project will assess the effects of consuming different proportions of red meat (RM) and plant-based, protein-rich foods (nuts, seeds, and soy products - NSS) incorporated into a U.S. Healthy Eating Pattern (HEP) on cardiovascular disease risk factors in adults at high risk of developing a heart-related disease.
